description: Foe attacks next turn can't\nmiss and do double damage.

name: Revival Blessing
description: Revives a fainted party\nmember and heals half its HP.

name: Salt Cure
description: Hurts foe every turn. Double\ndamage to Steel and Water.

name: Triple Dive
description: Hits target with splashes\nof water 3 times in a row.

name: Mortal Spin
description: Erases trap moves and Leech\nSeed. Poisons all foes.

name: Doodle

description: Tackle that breaks barriers.\nUser's form determines type.

name: Make It Rain
description: Lowers the user's Sp. Atk.\nMoney is recovered after.

description: Summons a ruinous disaster\nand cuts half the foe's HP.

description: Prehistoric explosion that's\nstronger if super effective.

name: Electro Drift
description: Futuristic electricity. It's\nstronger if super effective.

name: Shed Tail
description: Creates a Substitute for\nitself before switching out.

name: Chilly Reception
description: Bad joke summons snowstorm.\nThe user also switches out.

name: Tidy Up
description: User tidies up hazards and\nraises its Attack and Speed.

name: Pounce

name: Trailblaze
description: The user attacks suddenly,\nraising its Speed.

name: Twin Beam

name: Comeuppance

name: Aqua Cutter

name: Psyblade

name: Hydro Steam
description: This move's power increases\nunder harsh sunlight.

name: Matcha Gotcha
description: Absorbs half the damage\ninflicted. May cause a burn.

name: Thunderclap

name: Mighty Cleave

name: Tachyon Cutter
description: Launches particle blades at\nthe target. Strikes twice.

name: Hard Press
description: The more HP the foe has,\nthe greater the power.

name: Dragon Cheer
description: Raises allies' critical-hit\nratio, sharply if Dragons.

name: Alluring Voice
description: Confuses foe if its stats\nwere raised this turn.

name: Temper Flare

name: Supercell Slam
description: An electrified slam. If it\nmisses, the user is hurt.

name: Psychic Noise
description: Sound waves that damage and\nprevent healing for 2 turns.

name: Upper Hand

name: Malignant Chain
description: A corrosive chain attack\nthat may badly poison.
